citation.title: Comparison of two transpulmonary pressure-based positive end-expiratory pressure titration strategies in acute respiratory distress syndrome: a randomized crossover study

provenance.quote: Patients older than 18 years with ARDS according to the Berlin definition
They were ventilated using an Engström® or Carescape R860® ventilator
The study was conducted in the medical Intensive Care Unit (ICU) of the Angers University Hospital (France)
In the PL, exp strategy, PEEP was set to target a directly measured PL, exp... In the PL, insp strategy, PEEP was set to maintain the calculated PL, insp...

Pes measurements were obtained with a dedicated nasogastric feeding tube equipped with an esophageal balloon (NutriVent®, Sidam, San Giacomo Roncole, Italy)

method_verbatim.value: The balloon was consecutively inflated to achieve a filling volume of 2, 3 and 4 mL. Finally, the volume insufflated in the esophageal balloon for the measurements was defined as the one allowing to obtain the maximal tidal Pes.

provenance.quote: The balloon was consecutively inflated to achieve a filling volume of 2, 3 and 4 mL. Finally, the volume insufflated in the esophageal balloon for the measurements was defined as the one allowing to obtain the maximal tidal Pes.

position_verification.value: Correct positioning of the esophageal balloon was then verified by chest radiography and an occlusion test (modified Baydur’s maneuver).

provenance.quote: Correct positioning of the esophageal balloon was then verified by chest radiography and an occlusion test (modified Baydur’s maneuver).

occlusion_ratio_acceptance.value: A ratio of Pes swing to Paw swing (ΔPes/ΔPaw) during the occlusion test was considered acceptable if comprised between 0.8 and 1.2.

provenance.quote: A ratio of Pes swing to Paw swing (ΔPes/ΔPaw) during the occlusion test was considered acceptable if comprised between 0.8 and 1.2.

method_verbatim.value: In the PL, exp strategy, PEEP was set to target a directly measured PL, exp (PL, exp = total PEEP – expiratory Pes) of 0 to 10 cmH2O depending on the severity of hypoxemia using a PL, exp/FiO2 table as proposed by Talmor et al. In the PL, insp strategy, PEEP was set to maintain the calculated PL, insp using EL/ERS ratio (PL, insp = Pplat x EL/ERS) between 20 and 22 cmH2O.

provenance.quote: In the PL, exp strategy, PEEP was set to target a directly measured PL, exp (PL, exp = total PEEP – expiratory Pes) of 0 to 10 cmH2O depending on the severity of hypoxemia using a PL, exp/FiO2 table as proposed by Talmor et al. In the PL, insp strategy, PEEP was set to maintain the calculated PL, insp using EL/ERS ratio (PL, insp = Pplat x EL/ERS) between 20 and 22 cmH2O.

strategy_verbatim.value: In the PL, exp strategy, PEEP was set to target a directly measured PL, exp... of 0 to 10 cmH2O... In the PL, insp strategy, PEEP was set to maintain the calculated PL, insp... between 20 and 22 cmH2O.

provenance.quote: In the PL, exp strategy, PEEP was set to target a directly measured PL, exp (PL, exp = total PEEP – expiratory Pes) of 0 to 10 cmH2O depending on the severity of hypoxemia using a PL, exp/FiO2 table as proposed by Talmor et al. In the PL, insp strategy, PEEP was set to maintain the calculated PL, insp using EL/ERS ratio (PL, insp = Pplat x EL/ERS) between 20 and 22 cmH2O.
In both tested strategies, the maximum level of PEEP was limited to 24 cmH2O for safety reasons.

titration_frequency.value: Each strategy applied for 45 minutes once.

provenance.quote: The two tested PL-based PEEP titration strategies were applied for 45 min each in a randomized order.
Vt was set to 6 mL/kg of predicted body weight (PBW)

other_co_interventions.value: Respiratory rate set to maintain pH between 7.35 and 7.45; FiO2 set to maintain pulsed oxygen saturation between 92 and 98%.

provenance.quote: respiratory rate was set to maintain pH between 7.35 and 7.45, and FiO₂ was set to maintain pulsed oxygen saturation between 92 and 98%.

timing_verbatim.value: Enrolled within 72 h after the diagnosis of ARDS; strategies applied after 45 min at PEEP 5 and 45 min at Express PEEP.

provenance.quote: The two tested PL-based PEEP titration strategies (PL, exp and PL, insp strategies) were applied for 45 min each in a randomized order. A 45-minute washout period (Express strategy) was applied between the two tested strategy.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: Timing from ARDS diagnosis to inclusion median 39h (IQR 27-51), so some patients >48h. Mixed.

reported_subgroups.result_verbatim: PEEPPL, insp was higher than PEEPPL, exp in the non-obese patients (n=11; 16 (14-18.5) cmH2O and 10 (7.5–15) cmH2O, respectively; p=0.03). But no difference was observed between PEEPPL, insp and PEEPPL, exp in the obese patients (n=9; 16 (12–18) cmH2O and 15 (15–18) cmH2O, respectively; p=0.78)

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Suspected overlap with pavlovsky_2024 per COHORTS.md (same ICU, shared authorship). Could not confirm as pavlovsky_2024 report not available. Registration NCT03281473 and enrolment Oct 2018-Jan 2022 stated; no comparison possible.
unclear_items: Potential overlap with pavlovsky_2024 unverified due to missing report.

PEEPExpress baseline values not extracted because not part of the randomized comparison.

extraction_flags.general_notes: Physiological crossover study comparing two esophageal balloon-guided PEEP titration strategies. No standard care comparator. ICU mortality reported but not primary.
